top demo/tb_ne.shbench for Ngspice
== analogLib/res.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/res"
  vibox none
  vsym 1101032df2f5824a

pin PLUS inout 0 -30
  vplabel none
pin MINUS inout 0 30
  vplabel none

param r 1k
  unit Ohm
  doc Resistance
param m 1
  doc Multiplier

impl spice spice
  format spice "R{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} {r} m={m}"
  format spectre "{name} ({PLUS} {MINUS}) resistor r={r} m={m}"

rect -6 -20 6 20
== analogLib/vdc.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/vdc"
  vibox none
  vsym b2e0aa0db7f823b7

pin PLUS inout 0 -30
  vplabel none
pin MINUS inout 0 30
  vplabel none

param vdc ""
  kind string
  unit V
  doc "DC voltage"
param acm 0
  unit V
  doc "AC magnitude"
param acp 0
  unit deg
  doc "AC phase"

impl spice spice
  format spice "V{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} dc {vdc} ac {acm} {acp}"
  format spectre "{name} ({PLUS} {MINUS}) vsource{vdc != \"\" ? \" dc=\" + vdc : \"\"} mag={acm} phase={acp}"

circle 0 0 15
== demo/ne.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  vibox none
  vsym dbaf51c5ebf5ac30
  vsch 529f1662c30fc612
  vcdf 6b471fcf5fb59eec
  vcdfrec "(\"cdf\" \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"spectre\" ((\"termOrder\" (\"A\"))))"

pin A in -40 0
  vplabel none
pin vdd inout 0 0
  inherit vdd

impl schematic schematic

rect -20 -20 20 20

inst nbwwat analogLib:res
  at 0 0 R0
  name R0

wire kcf1wb 0 -50 0 -30
wire ppt8fj 0 30 0 60

label cc2c60 0 -48 R270 vdd
  vexpr [@vdd:%:vdd!]
  voff 2 0

port pq533p 0 60 R270 A
== demo/tb_ne.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  vsch 86f45acaf11386aa

inst 4hmqt8 ./ne
  at 0 0 R0
  name I0
  inherit vdd VDDA
inst 5zz3dj analogLib:vdc
  at -80 40 R0
  name V1
  vdc 1
inst bq7ctq analogLib:vdc
  at -120 40 R0
  name V0
  vdc 3.3

wire 45eq8r -120 -10 -120 10
wire 6vawys -80 0 -40 0
wire nvehcj -80 0 -80 10

label 5yde3w -120 -10 R0 VDDA
label 65rkdg -120 70 R0 0
  vinst I1
label 6n20v1 -80 70 R0 0
  vinst I2
label jaq0zs -60 0 R0 a
